exclusions.reason: Epic #2 excludes OmniRoute. No pin, adapter, manifest entry, profile value or documented path in this stack may reference it.

host_surfaces: multi-agent v2 collaboration tool construction (spawn_agent, send_message, followup_task)
recipient rendering of agent_message in the parent/child transcript
components.failure_behavior: Build without the patch to disable. Already-written ciphertext stays ciphertext: nothing in this stack decrypts existing records.
Disable by uninstalling the package or by not loading its hooks; capture and retrieval degrade to absent, never to fabricated evidence.

components.license: MIT (declared in package metadata; repository LICENSE file is not present)
components.failure_behavior: A declined, errored, timed-out or malformed stage contributes nothing; the chain continues from that stage's own input.

unsupported: re-running PreToolUse for an existing exec session via write_stdin
codex_coverage.trust: Non-managed Codex hooks require exact-definition hash trust approval in /hooks; staging a file never bypasses that review.

components.failure_behavior: Invalid or unsupported hook output can be treated as hook failure with the tool continuing. Veto outcomes are host-owned enforcement, not a permission grant.

blob_check_result.note: Both expected blobs are byte-identical at the integration pin and at the component's own inspected commit, so the transform may be applied at the integration revision without porting.

host_surfaces: guardian synchronous review attempt (eligible paths only)

credentials.consent_control: allow_remote_context must be explicitly true; default false

components.failure_behavior: Unset CODEX_JEV_* variables start no process and the original review route remains. Absent, stale, failed or uncertain results never grant permission.

patch_order.note: The jev-bus carrier and stage invoker (issues #15-#17) is the last source change, so it can call into the approval and collaboration surfaces already in place.

bus.contract_document: docs/BUS.md, vendored byte-identical in jev-context-fabric and jev-prune-kit

registry.mode: additive metadata, never a file-ownership claim

stages.transform: substitutes duplicate read bodies in place without changing array length
removes approved assistant prose and appends retrieved evidence

native_carrier.amendment: codex is added as a carrier host whose carrier is the integration host itself, not a package. The packages keep refusing a codex carrier claim, TRANSFORM_HOSTS and the hash-pinned vendored files are unchanged, and priority order (100 before 200) plus single-invocation semantics hold exactly as documented.

feature_switches.name: collab_plaintext
feature_switches.enable: build from a checkout with the patch applied

feature_switches.name: fabric_capture
feature_switches.enable: install the package into the isolated profile
feature_switches.disable: uninstall, or leave hooks.json without the package's entries

feature_switches.name: dedup_projection
feature_switches.enable: carrier invokes the registered dedup stage
feature_switches.disable: omit the stage from the resolved chain

feature_switches.name: prose_view
feature_switches.enable: apply an approved, unexpired prose-view plan

feature_switches.name: sentinel_hooks
feature_switches.enable: install into the isolated profile and complete Codex hook trust approval

feature_switches.name: sentinel_enforce
feature_switches.enable: explicit operator configuration after shadow evidence is reviewed

feature_switches.name: approval_preflight
feature_switches.enable: CODEX_JEV_PYTHON, CODEX_JEV_LAUNCHER, CODEX_JEV_CONFIG plus mode = shadow

feature_switches.name: approval_remote_context
feature_switches.enable: allow_remote_context = true with credentials provisioned separately

feature_switches.name: optional_remote_inference
feature_switches.enable: requires separate authorization and an explicit budget

rules: One turn yields one trace_id; every event names its immediate parent in parent_span_id.
Identifiers describe observed host identities only where the host supplies them; absent identifiers are absent, never synthesized.
Incident and projection records carry hashes and metadata, never raw secret-bearing payloads.

ownership.rule: One writable owner per worktree and per shared interface. Shared files are merged additively; each package removes only its own entries.

entries.rule: additive only; unrelated entries are preserved byte-for-byte
host codex entries are written only by codex-jev; package entries only by their package

network.run_time: none required; every stage runs locally

runtime_requirements.platform_note: The reference build environment has no system OpenSSL development files. codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml declares openssl 0.10 with the vendored feature as a build-environment adaptation; this is recorded in jev/docs/BUILD.md and is not part of any component pin.

supported_platforms.note: Integration, isolation and offline fixture evidence are produced here.
Upstream supports it; no evidence was produced in this integration.
Component installers document POSIX mode checks that are not an equivalent Windows ACL verifier.

unsupported_combinations.combination: a component revision other than the recorded pin
unsupported_combinations.behavior: fail explicitly; re-pin deliberately with a new manifest revision

unsupported_combinations.combination: the approval source transform at a revision whose guardian blobs differ
unsupported_combinations.behavior: fail explicitly; the transform refuses to apply

unsupported_combinations.combination: a carrier claim for host codex by a package
unsupported_combinations.behavior: refused; codex-jev is the sole carrier

unsupported_combinations.combination: remote inference without explicit authorization and budget
